audit.why: 52.46% over 1807 games. FAVOURED 4/10 holds: Heroic Swing needs terrain to anchor, so mid lane is the worst place on the map for his engage, and Frozen Tomb answers the swing outright.
audit.corrected: Difficulty kept; the terrain requirement written into the level-3 why and the cooldowns field.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers on rows 0-3: phases[0..3].side read 'Lissandra' while win[0..3] and the packet levelChart read 'Skill'.
audit.why: Neither champion has a kill pattern before 6 — his shield refunds your chip and Avengerang outranges your Q at 850 vs 725. The packet and content layer are right.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0..3].side to Skill at 5/10 as one atomic group with rewritten whys; win[0..3] already read Skill. Rows 4-6 already agree on Lissandra and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Comeuppance's blocking rule was never stated — it damages the first champion, minion or structure hit, so a minion or your own body absorbs the whole payload. Dirty Fighting's every-third-hit shield was also unmentioned, so the all-in maths on the page is wrong.
audit.why: Riot text on R: 'dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit'. Riot text on P: every three hits grants a shield against champions.
audit.corrected: Minion-block written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d and content spikes[3].text; the shield into dontsFull[2].d and enemyWin.
Rewritten around the real numbers plus the terrain requirement.

edits.before: You are the assassin's nightmare pick — root the dash, tomb the dive, and counter-kill the reset he no longer has.
edits.after: You are the assassin's nightmare pick — root his swing, tomb the dive, and self-tomb the Comeuppance he saved for you.

edits.before: Akshan wins by landing Heroic Swing, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Akshan wins by poking with Avengerang, shielding every third hit off Dirty Fighting, and finishing at range with Comeuppance.

edits.before: - Lissandra vs Akshan - Track: Akshan Heroic Swing. - Hold W for his gap-close — the root IS the matchup. - No commits into Heroic Swing. - The ultimate closes arguments; it doesn’t open them.
edits.after: - Lissandra vs Akshan - Track: Akshan Heroic Swing (18s). - Hold W for the swing — the root IS the matchup. - No commits into Heroic Swing. - The ultimate closes arguments; it doesn’t open them.

edits.before: Q-shatter the wave and chip his melee step-ups — your early Q harass is better than the lane gives it credit for.
edits.after: Q-shatter the wave and chip him when he steps up — Avengerang is 9s at rank 1, so he cannot poke you for free between throws.

edits.before: W online: anyone who closes onto you eats a root. The anti-engage layer is already real at level 2.
edits.after: W online at 10s, but Avengerang outranges it 850 to 725 — level 2 is even and decided by mana.

edits.before: E claw completes the kit — you now have the lane's strangest engage and a guaranteed exit. Greed carefully; the claw is slow.
edits.after: E claw completes the kit and his Heroic Swing arrives too — the swing needs terrain to anchor, so open-lane trades stay two-sided.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q spam stops hurting your mana. Chip Akshan every time he touches the wave.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q spam stops hurting your mana, but his shield refunds chip; the level stays even.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1 and it needs terrain to anchor — fight in open lane while it is down. - Comeuppance is 100/85/70 and stops on the first minion hit; keep the wave between you. - Your R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.
edits.after: When Comeuppance locks onto you, self-cast R — untargetable eats a missing-health payload, and any minion standing between you eats it instead.

edits.before: Clawing in with W on cooldown 'to poke' — an engage tool spent on chip damage is a Lissandra standing in melee range with no ice left.
edits.after: Committing while Dirty Fighting is stacked — every third hit shields him, so make him spend that proc on minions before your burst pays for it.

edits.before: You are the assassin's nightmare pick — root the dash, tomb the dive, and counter-kill the reset he no longer has.
edits.after: You are the assassin's nightmare pick — root his swing, tomb the dive, and self-tomb the Comeuppance he saved for you.

edits.before: In fights Akshan hunts backline and revives allies, but you're the frontline that E-Q's him out of his swing and R's his engage; he can never freely dive while your CC is up, so you control the tempo.
edits.after: In fights Akshan hunts your backline and revives allies off Scoundrel kills; Comeuppance stops on the first champion or minion hit, so body-block for your carry and self-R the release when it locks onto you.

notes: Rows 0-3 of the level chart were a full-vs-content disagreement (full said Lissandra, content and packet said Skill); resolved toward the packet as one atomic group with matching why rewrites. Riot's text says Heroic Swing 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain' but does not say whether Lissandra's W root or Q slow interrupt the swing mid-flight, so no claim about rooting him out of it was written; listed in unverified. breakdown.carry, ahead and breakdown.feeding remain templates — Akshan gives nothing specific there beyond the swing and Comeuppance lines already used, so they were left rather than fabricated.
